question: When is Guru Nanak Jayanti celebrated in India as per the Hindu lunar calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kartika Poornima**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Guru Nanak Jayanti, also known as Gurpurab, is celebrated on **Kartika Poornima**, the full moon day in the month of Kartik.
 
• This day marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the first Sikh Guru and the founder of Sikhism.
 
• Kartika Poornima typically falls in the months of October or November according to the Gregorian calendar.
 
• The celebrations include reading the Guru Granth Sahib, hymns, and organizing processions and community service activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guru Nanak Dev Ji**:

 
 
• Born on 15 April 1469, in Rai Bhoi Ki Talwandi (now in Pakistan), Guru Nanak was the founder of Sikhism.
 
• He emphasized the importance of meditation, equality, and social justice.
 
 
 
• **Kartika Poornima**:
 
 
• A significant day in the Hindu lunar calendar, celebrated as the full moon night in the Kartik month.
 
• It is also known as Tripuri Purnima and Deva-Diwali in different regions of India.
 
 
 
• **Sikhism**:
 
 
• A monotheistic religion founded in the late 15th century in the Punjab region of South Asia.
 
• Sikhism's sacred scripture is the Guru Granth Sahib, a compilation of teachings from Sikh Gurus and other saints.
 
 
 
• **Gurpurab Celebrations**:
 
 
• Gurpurab refers to the celebration of the birth anniversaries of Sikh Gurus.
 
• Key activities include Akhand Path (continuous reading of Guru Granth Sahib), processions (Nagar Kirtan), and Langar (community kitchen).
